name: J-Find (Designated Activities, Future Creation Individual)
summary: A job-hunting visa for graduates of highly ranked universities, with no employer needed. Your university has to be in the top 100 of at least 2 of the 3 world university rankings the agency uses, your degree has to be less than 5 years old, and you need savings of 200,000 yen. It gives you up to 2 years in Japan to find work or prepare to start a business.

requirements.text: Your university has to be in the top 100 of at least 2 of the 3 world university rankings the agency uses, whether you took your degree there or completed a graduate course there.

sources.quote: ３つの世界大学ランキング（※１）中、２つ以上で１００位以内にランクインしている大学（※２）を卒業、又はその大学の大学院の課程を修了して学位又は専門職学位を授与されていること。
sources.translation: Having graduated from a university (*2) ranked within the top 100 in two or more of the three world university rankings (*1), or having completed a graduate course at that university and been awarded a degree or a professional degree.

sources.quote: (*1) (1) QS World University Rankings published by Quacquarelli Simmons, (2) THE World University Rankings published by The Times, (3) Academic Ranking of World Universities published by Shanghai Ranking Consultancy

requirements.text: Check your university against the list the agency publishes, which was built from the rankings as of January 2026, and against the current rankings as well.

sources.quote: 対象となる大学は、以下を御参照ください（令和８年１月時点のランキングに基づき作成されているため、申請の際は、必ず最新の３つの世界大学ランキングも併せて御確認下さい。）。
sources.translation: For the universities covered, please refer to the following (because it was compiled on the basis of the rankings as of January Reiwa 8, when applying please be sure to check the latest three world university rankings as well).

sources.quote: A list of Universities eligible for J-Find

requirements.text: You need a degree or professional degree at bachelor's level or above from that university.

sources.quote: 大学又は大学院を卒業（又は修了）し、学士以上の学位を取得していることを証する文書
sources.translation: A document proving graduation (or completion) from a university or graduate school and acquisition of a bachelor's degree or above

requirements.text: No more than 5 years can have passed since the day your degree was awarded.

sources.quote: 上記の対象大学を卒業し、又は対象大学の大学院の課程を修了して、学位又は専門職学位（学位規則（昭和２８年文部省令第９号）第５条の２に規定する専門職学位をいい、外国において授与されたこれに相当する学位を含む。）を授与された日から５年以内の方。
sources.translation: A person within 5 years from the day on which they graduated from one of the covered universities above, or completed a graduate course at a covered university, and were awarded a degree or a professional degree (meaning a professional degree as provided in Article 5-2 of the Degree Regulations (Ministry of Education Ordinance No. 9 of Showa 28), and including an equivalent degree awarded in a foreign country).

requirements.text: You have to show savings of at least 200,000 yen at the time you apply, to live on at the start of your stay.

sources.quote: 滞在当初の生計維持費として、申請の時点において、申請人の預貯金の額が日本円に換算して２０万円以上あること。
sources.translation: That, as funds to maintain a livelihood at the beginning of the stay, the amount of the applicant's savings and deposits is 200,000 yen or more converted into Japanese yen, at the time of application.

sources.quote: Possession of 200,000 yen for living expenses at the beginning of stay

requirements.text: You have to be 18 or older.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
sources.quote: Individual at the age of 18 years or older who satisfies the following conditions and wish to participate in job hunting, entrepreneurial activity, or other remunerative activity for 2 years in Japan.

requirements.text: The visa is for looking for a job or preparing to start a business, and you can take work to supplement the money you need while you do it.

sources.quote: 優秀な海外大学等を卒業等した方が、本邦において「就職活動」又は「起業準備活動」を行う場合、在留資格「特定活動」（未来創造人材）を付与され、最長２年間の在留が可能となります。
sources.translation: Where a person who has graduated from an excellent overseas university or the like carries out "job-hunting activities" or "start-up preparation activities" in Japan, the status of residence "Designated Activities" (Future Creation Individual) is granted, and a stay of up to 2 years becomes possible.

sources.quote: Employment to supplement the funds necessary to carry out the above activities

requirements.text: You can stay up to 2 years in total, counting any earlier stay on a similar job-hunting or start-up scheme.

sources.quote: It means maximum period of stay is a total of 2 years, including past stays using similar programs such as Designated Activities (Continued Job Hunting), the

requirements.text: Applying from outside Japan means getting a Certificate of Eligibility first, which proves you meet the conditions for landing. You then show it when you apply for the visa at a Japanese embassy or consulate.

sources.quote: 新しくこの在留資格で日本への入国を希望する場合の申請です。
sources.translation: This is the application for those who wish to newly enter Japan under this status of residence.

sources.quote: 日本に入国しようとする外国人の方が、日本で行おうとする活動内容がいずれかの在留資格（「短期滞在」及び「永住者」を除く）に該当するものである等の上陸のための条件に適合していることを証明するために、入国前にあらかじめ行う申請です。
sources.translation: An application made in advance, before entry, by a foreign national intending to enter Japan, in order to prove that the content of the activity they intend to carry out in Japan falls under one of the statuses of residence (excluding "Temporary Visitor" and "Permanent Resident"), and that they meet the conditions for landing.

sources.quote: なお、交付された在留資格認定証明書は、在外公館における査証申請や上陸申請の際に提出・提示することにより、速やかに査証発給や上陸許可を受けることができます。
sources.translation: Furthermore, by submitting or presenting the issued Certificate of Eligibility when applying for a visa at an overseas diplomatic mission, or when applying for landing, a visa can be issued and landing permission obtained promptly.

requirements.text: The agency's published standard processing period for a Certificate of Eligibility is 1 to 3 months, so this is the step to start early.

sources.quote: 標準処理期間 １か月～３か月
sources.translation: Standard processing period: 1 month to 3 months
